# Using an effort in Pi

Use `using_effort` explicitly as `{ effort: "<canonical-slug>" }` to attach or `{ detach: true }` to detach. Pi remains at repository root; use the supplied relative memory path `.awf/efforts/<slug>/memory.md` and, when present, managed-worktree path `.awf/worktrees/<slug>` for effort work.

A takeover is advisory and proceeds. Heartbeat and complete metadata are advisory only. When available, awf publishes the effort slug as a display-only suffix; it never reads or composes a base name and the suffix is never routing input. Activity is neither authority nor a lock. Restart begins detached.

When attached, prefer `effort_memory_read` for pathless reads, `effort_memory_edit` only for Markdown body changes, and `effort_memory_update` for `phase` or `next`. Their timestamps are automatic. Generic file tools and direct awf commands remain available.


## Pi session replacement

After a persisted formal phase checkpoint, a persisted approval checkpoint, or another safe resumable effort point, judge retained-context relevance and successor work from current `[session context]` model-window and active-branch-compaction evidence. No fixed threshold controls this choice; continuing immediately is autonomous.

Either continue, or invoke `handoff_session` alone with kickoff exactly `Continue with effort <slug>.` The kickoff identifies only the effort: it carries no phase or task limit, association mechanic, resume procedure, or handoff-log instruction. If relevant discussion predates late effort creation, handoff is prohibited until effort-workflow initializes the owned memory from retained evidence. Keep the effort associated with `using_effort`; reorient from repository authority and the owned memory before substantive work.

Use a managed worktree only for pre-integration execution. Switch to the governed primary checkout for integration, deferred lifecycle closure, worktree removal, and retrospective. Handoff validates only canonical YAML effort identity; it does not validate mutable metadata, parse state or activity, select an effort, or mutate memory. A replacement session appends the actual boundary to `## Handoff log` before substantive work. Continuation, cancellation, or failure that leaves the old session active appends none.
